info.name: TiDB Cloud API Keys Schema API

items.docs: Returns schema information for all databases known to this TiDB instance. The response includes table names, column definitions, and index information as represented in the TiDB information schema.

params.name: id_name_only
params.description: If true, returns only table IDs and names without full schema details.

items.docs: Returns schema information for all tables in the specified database. Optionally set id_name_only to true to return only table IDs and names without the full column and index details, which is faster for large schemas.

params.name: table
params.description: The table name within the specified database.

params.name: table_id
params.description: Optional numeric table ID for lookup by ID instead of name.

items.docs: Returns the full schema definition for the specified table, including all column names, types, default values, and index definitions. Can also look up a table by numeric table_id or multiple table_ids for batch retrieval.

info.name: Get table info by table ID

params.name: tableID
params.description: The numeric TiDB internal table ID.

items.docs: Returns database information, table information, and the current TiDB info schema version for a specific table identified by its numeric table ID. This is useful for reverse lookups when you have a table ID from region information but need the associated database and table names.
